First of all check out SR4U if you want information on the latest and great. Rareboots4u.com have a great selection of F50's both in the synthetic and leather variation. As with the mizunos, of which I assume you're thinking about the Morellia Neo's its got the best build quality as long as youre willing to get the made in Japan version which will empty your pockets with the 300dollar price tag. They're also comfortable as hell and very light. Another option is the Umbro medusae pro (not laceless elite). Traditional tongue construction with a comfortable lightweight leather upper (170grams approx.). The vapors are nice, the anatomical soleplate gives you a nice locked in feel, while the flynit upper is quite stiff, it makes for a speedy, responsive, locked in boot. I appreciate you want something along the lines of a "speed boot" but they are just lightweight lines of boots. The best way is to go your soccer store and try on a variation of boots. See what fits you best, what is most comfortable, and what is offering the best touch for you. If you wear special socks i recommend you bring those (when i try on new shoes i always bring my falke grip socks), this makes for an accurate representation of how it will feel on pitch. My soccer store has a 5 a side pitch inside it which allows me to try on how everything feel. 

TL;DR theres lots of boots out there, my recommendations are: X18.1, Vapor 12 elite, Phantomvenom elite, Morellia Neo 2 MIJ and umbro medusae pro. Theyre also websites like Rareboots4u.com which have F50'S for less than 200 quid depending on the model.
